email_subject: Possible adverse event report - DemoBasalin patient with mild fatigue
email_body:
[SYNTHETIC / FICTIONAL DATA — educational prototype only, no real patient or reporter information]

Hello Safety Team,


I am a nurse practitioner at Fictional Community Clinic (a fabricated organization) and I would like to report a possible adverse event.

A 78-year-old female patient with a history of type 2 diabetes received their third dose of DemoBasalin (dose: 5 mg) via subcutaneous injection.
Treatment started on 2026-02-23.
Approximately 10 day(s) after that dose, the patient developed mild fatigue.

Please let me know if you need anything else.

Regards,
T. Larsen (fictional reporter)
Fictional Community Clinic
Contact: demo.reporter775@fictionalclinic-demo.example (synthetic contact info)
